This is the disease counterpart of
`new_script2_aging/13_aging_donor_pseudobulk_MultiNicheNet.Rmd`. The same core
method is retained: raw counts, one pseudobulk per donor and cell type,
`filterByExpr`, TMM effective-library-size normalization, edgeR donor-level
inference, and MultiNicheNet sample-level communication prioritization.

The disease design is intentionally different where the data require it:

- comparisons remain within their source dataset;
- dataset01 DCM-versus-NF and HCM-versus-NF are run separately;
- dataset08 DoxCM-versus-NF is a separate analysis;
- multiple specimens from one person are summed into one donor replicate;
- dataset11 HFpEF remains non-testable in the conservative >=25-LEC branch,
  but two explicitly exploratory within-dataset sensitivities use symmetric
  >=10- and >=15-final-LEC thresholds in both HFpEF and NF;
- completed comparison folders are checkpointed and reused when
  `resume_completed: true`, so knitting again does not reload raw matrices or
  rerun edgeR/MultiNicheNet for completed analyses;
- bare cell barcodes and bare donor labels are never used across datasets.

The Step 03 disease H5AD files contain log-normalized expression for clustering.
They are therefore **not** used as edgeR counts. This report reads the validated
raw-count locations in the original H5AD files directly with `rhdf5`, using the
recorded zero-based `source_row_index`. This avoids Python, reticulate, pyenv,
zellkonverter, and Git during H5AD import.

# Running in RStudio

1. Open this Rmd in RStudio.
2. Leave `validate_only: false` for the full analysis.
3. Click **Knit**. Do not use log-normalized Step 03 expression as a substitute
   for the raw-count import in this report.
4. The five comparisons run sequentially and may take several hours on the
   first complete run. The three previously completed >=25 analyses are reused
   automatically when `resume_completed: true`. Their
   output is written immediately under `new_result2_disease/12_NicheNet_donor_pseudobulk`,
   so an earlier completed comparison is preserved if a later one fails.
5. To test paths and metadata without reading the large count matrices, change
   `validate_only` to `true` and click **Knit**.
6. To run one comparison first, set `analyses_to_run`, for example, to
   `"dataset11_HFpEF_vs_NF_min10"`.
7. The selected raw matrices have conservative sparse-construction estimates
   of about 3.6 GB (DoxCM), 8.9 GB (DCM), and 10.8 GB (HCM), before temporary
   package copies and parallel workers. On a memory-limited computer, run one
   comparison at a time and change `n_cores` to `1`.

The complete run creates raw and normalized donor pseudobulks, edgeR tables and
diagnostics, MultiNicheNet group and sample prioritization tables, the ten
Sydney-equivalent figure types for each comparison, run configuration files,
and an explicit record of differences from the aging analysis.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6
)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, timeout = 1200)
set.seed(120820)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    expected <- c(
      file.path(current, "Data"),
      file.path(current, "new_result2_disease"),
      file.path(current, "new_script2_disease")
    )
    if (all(file.exists(expected))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop("Could not locate the project root from: ", start)
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- if (is.null(params$project_root) || !nzchar(params$project_root)) {
  find_project_root()
} else {
  normalizePath(params$project_root, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

resolve_project_path <- function(path, must_work = TRUE) {
  candidate <- if (grepl("^[A-Za-z]:|^/", path)) path else file.path(project_root, path)
  normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = must_work)
}

output_root <- resolve_project_path(params$output_root, must_work = FALSE)
dir.create(output_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!is.numeric(params$n_cores) || length(params$n_cores) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(params$n_cores) || params$n_cores < 1) {
  stop("n_cores must be one positive number.")
}
if (params$expressed_cell_fraction <= 0 || params$expressed_cell_fraction > 1 ||
    params$expressed_sample_fraction <= 0 || params$expressed_sample_fraction > 1) {
  stop("Expression fractions must be greater than 0 and at most 1.")
}
if (params$min_donors_per_group < 4) {
  stop("Disease MultiNicheNet requires at least four qualifying donors per group.")
}
if (params$maximum_sparse_matrix_gb <= 0) {
  stop("maximum_sparse_matrix_gb must be positive.")
}
if (!is.logical(params$resume_completed) || length(params$resume_completed) != 1L) {
  stop("resume_completed must be TRUE or FALSE.")
}

cran_packages <- c(
  "Matrix", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "readr", "purrr", "stringr",
  "ggplot2", "jsonlite", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "remotes"
)
bioc_packages <- c(
  "rhdf5", "SingleCellExperiment", "SummarizedExperiment", "S4Vectors",
  "edgeR", "limma", "ComplexHeatmap", "IHW", "muscat", "scater",
  "scran", "sva", "bluster"
)
github_packages <- c("nichenetr", "multinichenetr")
required_packages <- unique(c(cran_packages, bioc_packages, github_packages))

namespace_problem <- function(package) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages(loadNamespace(package)))
      NA_character_
    },
    error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)
  )
}
namespace_is_loadable <- function(package) is.na(namespace_problem(package))

install_missing_dependencies <- function() {
  options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"), timeout = 1200)
  bootstrap <- c("BiocManager", "remotes")
  missing_bootstrap <- bootstrap[!vapply(bootstrap, namespace_is_loadable, logical(1))]
  if (length(missing_bootstrap)) install.packages(missing_bootstrap, dependencies = NA)

  missing_cran <- cran_packages[!vapply(cran_packages, namespace_is_loadable, logical(1))]
  if (length(missing_cran)) install.packages(missing_cran, dependencies = NA)

  missing_bioc <- bioc_packages[!vapply(bioc_packages, namespace_is_loadable, logical(1))]
  if (length(missing_bioc)) {
    BiocManager::install(missing_bioc, ask = FALSE, update = FALSE, dependencies = NA)
  }

  if (!namespace_is_loadable("nichenetr") ||
      packageVersion("nichenetr") < "2.0.5") {
    remotes::install_github(
      "saeyslab/nichenetr",
      dependencies = NA,
      upgrade = "never",
      build_vignettes = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (!namespace_is_loadable("multinichenetr") ||
      packageVersion("multinichenetr") < "2.0.0") {
    remotes::install_github(
      "saeyslab/multinichenetr",
      dependencies = NA,
      upgrade = "never",
      build_vignettes = FALSE
    )
  }
}

missing_or_broken <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, namespace_is_loadable, logical(1))
]
if (length(missing_or_broken) && isTRUE(params$install_missing_packages)) {
  install_missing_dependencies()
}
missing_or_broken <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, namespace_is_loadable, logical(1))
]
if (length(missing_or_broken)) {
  details <- vapply(
    missing_or_broken,
    function(package) paste0("  - ", package, ": ", namespace_problem(package)),
    character(1)
  )
  stop(
    "Required R packages are unavailable. Set install_missing_packages: true, knit once, ",
    "restart R if requested, and knit again.\n",
    paste(details, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  # nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols() in the installed release refers to
  # lazy-loaded package data in the attached package environment.
  library(nichenetr)
  library(multinichenetr)
})
```

```{r configuration}
write_csv_safe <- function(x, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_csv(as.data.frame(x), path, na = "")
  invisible(path)
}

write_if_data_frame <- function(x, path) {
  if (is.data.frame(x)) write_csv_safe(x, path)
  invisible(path)
}

write_text_safe <- function(lines, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  writeLines(enc2utf8(lines), path, useBytes = TRUE)
  invisible(path)
}

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

clean_text <- function(x) {
  result <- trimws(as.character(x))
  result[is.na(x) | result %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "None", "nan")] <- NA_character_
  result
}

    dataset,

    paste0(dataset, "_", condition, "_celltypist_cell_predictions.csv.gz")

    "new_result2_disease/03",

empty_figure <- function(path, title, detail, width = 8, height = 6) {
  plot <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.1, label = title, fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = -0.1, label = detail, size = 3.5) +
    xlim(-1, 1) + ylim(-0.5, 0.5) + theme_void()
  ggsave(path, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
}

estimate_sparse_gb <- function(nnz) {
  # Approximate dgCMatrix payload plus construction vectors; deliberately conservative.
  as.numeric(nnz) * 28 / 1024^3
}

comparison_completion_files <- function(comparison_dir) {
  required <- c(
    file.path(comparison_dir, "12_run_summary.csv"),
    file.path(comparison_dir, "12_run_config.json"),
    file.path(comparison_dir, "tables", "12_edgeR_primary_all_genes.csv.gz")
  )
  if (isTRUE(params$run_multinichenet)) {
    required <- c(required, file.path(comparison_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_output.rds"))
  }
  if (isTRUE(params$run_multinichenet) &&
      isTRUE(params$make_sydney_equivalent_figures)) {
    required <- c(
      required,
      file.path(comparison_dir, "12_Sydney_equivalent_figure_manifest.csv")
    )
  }
  required
}

load_completed_summary <- function(spec, comparison_dir) {
  if (!isTRUE(params$resume_completed) || isTRUE(params$validate_only)) return(NULL)
  required <- comparison_completion_files(comparison_dir)
  if (!all(file.exists(required)) || any(file.info(required)$size <= 0)) return(NULL)
  summary <- tryCatch(
    readr::read_csv(
      file.path(comparison_dir, "12_run_summary.csv"),
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      progress = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(summary) || nrow(summary) != 1L ||
      !identical(as.character(summary$analysis_id), as.character(spec$analysis_id)) ||
      !identical(as.character(summary$status), "completed")) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  config <- tryCatch(
    jsonlite::read_json(file.path(comparison_dir, "12_run_config.json")),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(config) ||
      !identical(as.character(config$analysis_id), as.character(spec$analysis_id)) ||
      !isTRUE(all.equal(
        as.numeric(config$min_receiver_cells_per_donor),
        as.numeric(spec$receiver_min_cells)
      ))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  summary %>% mutate(
    analysis_tier = spec$analysis_tier,
    receiver_min_cells = spec$receiver_min_cells,
    execution_action = "reused_completed_checkpoint"
  )
}
```

# Donor manifest and disease design

```{r validate-donor-manifest}
primary_manifest <- readr::read_csv(
  input_paths$primary_donor_manifest,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)
all_donor_mapping <- readr::read_csv(
  input_paths$all_donor_filter_mapping,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)

required_mapping_columns <- c(
  "donor_key", "dataset_folder", "condition", "sex", "age", "n_final_LECs",
  "retained_minimum_LECs"
)
missing_mapping_columns <- setdiff(required_mapping_columns, names(all_donor_mapping))
if (length(missing_mapping_columns)) {
  stop("All-donor filter mapping is missing: ", paste(missing_mapping_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

primary_flags <- primary_manifest %>%
  transmute(
    analysis_donor_key = clean_text(analysis_donor_key),
    used_in_primary_within_dataset_test = as_flag(used_in_primary_within_dataset_test)
  )

final_lec_sample_counts <- readr::read_csv(
  input_paths$final_lec_metadata,
  col_select = c(
    donor_key, sample_key, final_LEC_by_majority_vote,
    celltypist_majority_vote
  ),
  col_types = cols(
    donor_key = col_character(),
    sample_key = col_character(),
    final_LEC_by_majority_vote = col_character(),
    celltypist_majority_vote = col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(
    final_LEC_by_majority_vote == "LEC",
    celltypist_majority_vote == "EC8_ln"
  ) %>%
  mutate(donor_key = clean_text(donor_key), sample_key = clean_text(sample_key)) %>%
  group_by(donor_key) %>%
  summarise(
    n_final_LECs_metadata = n(),
    n_final_LEC_samples_contributing = n_distinct(sample_key, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

donor_manifest_all <- all_donor_mapping %>%
  rename(
    analysis_donor_key = donor_key,
    n_final_LECs_used = n_final_LECs
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    analysis_donor_key = clean_text(analysis_donor_key),
    dataset_folder = clean_text(dataset_folder),
    condition = clean_text(condition),
    sex = clean_text(sex),
    age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(age)),
    n_final_LECs_used = as.integer(n_final_LECs_used),
    retained_minimum_LECs = as_flag(retained_minimum_LECs)
  ) %>%
  left_join(primary_flags, by = "analysis_donor_key") %>%
  left_join(
    final_lec_sample_counts,
    by = c("analysis_donor_key" = "donor_key")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    used_in_primary_within_dataset_test = coalesce(
      used_in_primary_within_dataset_test,
      FALSE
    ),
    n_final_LEC_samples_contributing = as.integer(
      n_final_LEC_samples_contributing
    )
  )

required_manifest_columns <- c(
  "analysis_donor_key", "dataset_folder", "condition", "sex", "age",
  "n_final_LECs_used", "used_in_primary_within_dataset_test",
  "n_final_LEC_samples_contributing"
)
missing_manifest_columns <- setdiff(required_manifest_columns, names(donor_manifest_all))
if (length(missing_manifest_columns)) {
  stop("Disease donor manifest is missing: ", paste(missing_manifest_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

if (anyDuplicated(donor_manifest_all$analysis_donor_key)) {
  stop("analysis_donor_key is duplicated in the disease donor manifest.")
}
if (anyNA(donor_manifest_all$n_final_LECs_used) ||
    any(donor_manifest_all$n_final_LECs_used < 1L)) {
  stop("The all-donor mapping contains an invalid final-LEC count.")
}
if (anyNA(donor_manifest_all$n_final_LECs_metadata) ||
    any(donor_manifest_all$n_final_LECs_used != donor_manifest_all$n_final_LECs_metadata)) {
  stop("All-donor final-LEC counts disagree with the current Step 08 metadata.")
}
if (anyNA(donor_manifest_all$n_final_LEC_samples_contributing) ||
    any(donor_manifest_all$n_final_LEC_samples_contributing < 1L)) {
  stop("At least one final-LEC donor has no contributing sample key.")
}

manifest_summary <- donor_manifest_all %>%
  count(
    dataset_folder, condition, retained_minimum_LECs,
    used_in_primary_within_dataset_test,
    name = "n_donors"
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset_folder, condition)
write_csv_safe(manifest_summary, file.path(output_root, "12_donor_manifest_summary.csv"))

expected_counts <- tribble(
  ~analysis_id, ~condition, ~expected_n,
  "dataset01_DCM_vs_NF", "NF", 12L,
  "dataset01_DCM_vs_NF", "DCM", 10L,
  "dataset01_HCM_vs_NF", "NF", 12L,
  "dataset01_HCM_vs_NF", "HCM", 15L,
  "dataset08_DoxCM_vs_NF", "NF", 4L,
  "dataset08_DoxCM_vs_NF", "DoxCM", 9L,
  "dataset11_HFpEF_vs_NF_min10", "NF", 6L,
  "dataset11_HFpEF_vs_NF_min10", "HFpEF", 7L,
  "dataset11_HFpEF_vs_NF_min15", "NF", 4L,
  "dataset11_HFpEF_vs_NF_min15", "HFpEF", 5L
)
observed_counts <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(comparison_specs_catalog)),
  function(index) {
    current <- comparison_specs_catalog[index, ]
    donor_manifest_all %>%
      filter(
        dataset_folder == current$dataset_folder,
        condition %in% c(current$reference, current$disease),
        n_final_LECs_used >= current$receiver_min_cells
      ) %>%
      count(condition, name = "observed_n") %>%
      mutate(
        analysis_id = current$analysis_id,
        receiver_min_cells = current$receiver_min_cells
      )
  }
)
count_check <- expected_counts %>%
  left_join(observed_counts, by = c("analysis_id", "condition")) %>%
  mutate(
    observed_n = coalesce(observed_n, 0L),
    matches = expected_n == observed_n
  )
if (!all(count_check$matches)) {
  stop("Disease comparison donor counts no longer match the validated donor inventory.")
}
write_csv_safe(count_check, file.path(output_root, "12_expected_donor_count_check.csv"))

hfpef_threshold_support <- tidyr::crossing(
  receiver_min_cells = c(10L, 15L, 25L),
  condition = c("NF", "HFpEF")
) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_donors = sum(
      donor_manifest_all$dataset_folder == "dataset11" &
        donor_manifest_all$condition == condition &
        donor_manifest_all$n_final_LECs_used >= receiver_min_cells
    ),
    n_final_LECs = sum(
      donor_manifest_all$n_final_LECs_used[
        donor_manifest_all$dataset_folder == "dataset11" &
          donor_manifest_all$condition == condition &
          donor_manifest_all$n_final_LECs_used >= receiver_min_cells
      ]
    ),
    inference_role = case_when(
      receiver_min_cells == 10L ~ "exploratory_primary_within_dataset",
      receiver_min_cells == 15L ~ "threshold_sensitivity_within_dataset",
      TRUE ~ "conservative_branch_not_testable"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
write_csv_safe(
  hfpef_threshold_support,
  file.path(output_root, "12_dataset11_HFpEF_receiver_threshold_support.csv")
)
write_csv_safe(
  hfpef_threshold_support %>% filter(receiver_min_cells == 25L),
  file.path(output_root, "12_dataset11_HFpEF_descriptive_only.csv")
)
```

# NicheNet v2 resources

The same human NicheNet v2 ligand-receptor and ligand-target resources used by
the aging report are reused. The analysis first checks the existing aging cache,
so a completed aging run does not download another copy of the 250 MB
ligand-target matrix.

```{r acquire-networks}
download_if_missing <- function(url, destination, expected_min_bytes = 1) {
  if (file.exists(destination) &&
      !is.na(file.info(destination)$size) &&
      file.info(destination)$size >= expected_min_bytes) {
    return(invisible(destination))
  }
  if (!isTRUE(params$allow_network_download)) {
    stop("Missing NicheNet resource and allow_network_download is false: ", destination)
  }
  dir.create(dirname(destination), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  partial <- paste0(destination, ".partial")
  if (file.exists(partial)) unlink(partial)
  message("Downloading NicheNet resource: ", basename(destination))
  download.file(url, partial, mode = "wb", quiet = FALSE)
  if (!file.exists(partial) || file.info(partial)$size < expected_min_bytes) {
    if (file.exists(partial)) unlink(partial)
    stop("Incomplete NicheNet download: ", destination)
  }
  if (!file.rename(partial, destination)) {
    unlink(partial)
    stop("Could not finalize NicheNet resource: ", destination)
  }
  invisible(destination)
}

network_urls <- c(
  lr_network = paste0(
    "https://zenodo.org/record/10229222/files/",
    "lr_network_human_allInfo_30112033.rds"
  ),
  ligand_target_matrix = paste0(
    "https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/",
    "ligand_target_matrix_nsga2r_final.rds"
  ),
  weighted_networks = paste0(
    "https://zenodo.org/record/7074291/files/",
    "weighted_networks_nsga2r_final.rds"
  )
)
network_min_bytes <- c(
  lr_network = 200000,
  ligand_target_matrix = 250000000,
  weighted_networks = 70000000
)
network_paths <- setNames(
  file.path(network_cache_dir, basename(network_urls)),
  names(network_urls)
)

if (isTRUE(params$run_multinichenet) && !isTRUE(params$validate_only)) {
  for (resource_name in names(network_urls)) {
    if (resource_name == "weighted_networks" &&
        !isTRUE(params$make_sydney_equivalent_figures)) next
    download_if_missing(
      network_urls[[resource_name]],
      network_paths[[resource_name]],
      network_min_bytes[[resource_name]]
    )
  }
}
write_csv_safe(
  tibble(
    resource = names(network_urls),
    url = unname(network_urls),
    local_path = unname(network_paths),
    exists = file.exists(unname(network_paths))
  ),
  file.path(output_root, "12_NicheNet_network_manifest.csv")
)

lr_network <- NULL
ligand_target_matrix <- NULL
weighted_networks <- NULL
if (isTRUE(params$run_multinichenet) && !isTRUE(params$validate_only)) {
  lr_network_all <- readRDS(network_paths[["lr_network"]]) %>%
    transmute(
      ligand = make.names(nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(ligand, "human")),
      receptor = make.names(nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(receptor, "human"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ligand), !is.na(receptor), nzchar(ligand), nzchar(receptor))
  lr_network <- distinct(lr_network_all, ligand, receptor)

  ligand_target_matrix <- readRDS(network_paths[["ligand_target_matrix"]])
  converted_ligands <- nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(
    colnames(ligand_target_matrix), organism = "human"
  )
  converted_targets <- nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(
    rownames(ligand_target_matrix), organism = "human"
  )
  converted_ligands[is.na(converted_ligands) | !nzchar(converted_ligands)] <-
    colnames(ligand_target_matrix)[is.na(converted_ligands) | !nzchar(converted_ligands)]
  converted_targets[is.na(converted_targets) | !nzchar(converted_targets)] <-
    rownames(ligand_target_matrix)[is.na(converted_targets) | !nzchar(converted_targets)]
  colnames(ligand_target_matrix) <- make.names(converted_ligands)
  rownames(ligand_target_matrix) <- make.names(converted_targets)

  lr_network <- lr_network %>%
    filter(ligand %in% colnames(ligand_target_matrix))
  ligand_target_matrix <- ligand_target_matrix[
    , unique(lr_network$ligand), drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (isTRUE(params$make_sydney_equivalent_figures)) {
    weighted_networks <- readRDS(network_paths[["weighted_networks"]])
    weighted_networks$lr_sig <- weighted_networks$lr_sig %>%
      transmute(
        from = make.names(from),
        to = make.names(to),
        weight = as.numeric(weight)
      )
  }
}
```

# Metadata recovery and cell-type eligibility

```{r metadata-functions}
read_h5ad_categorical_obs <- function(h5_file, column) {
  base_path <- paste0("/obs/", column)
  codes <- as.integer(rhdf5::h5read(h5_file, paste0(base_path, "/codes")))
  categories <- as.character(
    rhdf5::h5read(h5_file, paste0(base_path, "/categories"))
  )
  values <- rep(NA_character_, length(codes))
  valid <- !is.na(codes) & codes >= 0L & codes < length(categories)
  values[valid] <- categories[codes[valid] + 1L]
  values
}

read_step05_predictions <- function(dataset, conditions) {
  bind_rows(lapply(conditions, function(condition) {
    path <- step05_prediction_path(dataset, condition)
    step03_path <- step03_clustered_path(dataset, condition)
    message("Reading Step05 annotations: ", path)
    predictions <- readr::read_csv(
      path,
      col_select = c(
        cell_id, source_row_index, dataset_folder, condition,
        donor_key, celltypist_majority_vote
      ),
      col_types = cols(
        cell_id = col_character(),
        source_row_index = col_double(),
        dataset_folder = col_character(),
        condition = col_character(),
        donor_key = col_character(),
        celltypist_majority_vote = col_character()
      ),
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      progress = FALSE
    ) %>%
      rename(step05_row_index = source_row_index)

    # Step05 source_row_index is the zero-based row inside the filtered Step03
    # H5AD, not the row in the original source H5AD. Recover the original row
    # from the Step03 obs table and join by the globally namespaced cell ID.
    step03_cells <- as.character(rhdf5::h5read(step03_path, "/obs/_index"))
    original_rows <- as.integer(
      rhdf5::h5read(step03_path, "/obs/source_row_index")
    )
    author_celltype <- read_h5ad_categorical_obs(
      step03_path,
      "cell_type_leiden0.6"
    )
    if (length(step03_cells) != length(original_rows) ||
        length(step03_cells) != length(author_celltype) ||
        anyDuplicated(step03_cells) || anyDuplicated(original_rows)) {
      stop(dataset, "/", condition, ": invalid Step03 original-row mapping.")
    }
    predictions %>%
      left_join(
        tibble(
          cell_id = step03_cells,
          source_row_index = original_rows,
          author_celltype = author_celltype
        ),
        by = "cell_id"
      )
  })) %>%
    mutate(
      source_row_index = as.integer(source_row_index),
      step05_row_index = as.integer(step05_row_index),
      donor_key = clean_text(donor_key),
      celltypist_majority_vote = clean_text(celltypist_majority_vote),
      author_celltype = clean_text(author_celltype)
    )
}

read_final_lec_metadata <- function() {
  readr::read_csv(
    input_paths$final_lec_metadata,
    col_select = c(
      source_cell_id, source_row_index, dataset_folder, condition,
      donor_key, celltypist_majority_vote, final_LEC_by_majority_vote
    ),
    col_types = cols(
      source_cell_id = col_character(),
      source_row_index = col_double(),
      dataset_folder = col_character(),
      condition = col_character(),
      donor_key = col_character(),
      celltypist_majority_vote = col_character(),
      final_LEC_by_majority_vote = col_character()
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      source_row_index = as.integer(source_row_index),
      donor_key = clean_text(donor_key)
    )
}

prepare_comparison_metadata <- function(spec, comparison_manifest, final_lec_all) {
  groups <- c(spec$reference, spec$disease)
  metadata <- read_step05_predictions(spec$dataset_folder, groups) %>%
    filter(
      dataset_folder == spec$dataset_folder,
      condition %in% groups,
      donor_key %in% comparison_manifest$analysis_donor_key
    )

  if (!nrow(metadata)) stop(spec$analysis_id, ": no Step05 cells matched retained donors.")
  if (anyDuplicated(metadata$cell_id)) stop(spec$analysis_id, ": duplicated Step05 cell IDs.")
  if (anyDuplicated(metadata$source_row_index)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": duplicated source_row_index values within one source H5AD.")
  }
  if (anyNA(metadata$source_row_index) || any(metadata$source_row_index < 0)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": invalid zero-based source_row_index values.")
  }

  donor_condition <- metadata %>% distinct(donor_key, condition)
  if (anyDuplicated(donor_condition$donor_key)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": at least one donor maps to more than one condition.")
  }

  final_lec <- final_lec_all %>%
    filter(
      dataset_folder == spec$dataset_folder,
      condition %in% groups,
      donor_key %in% comparison_manifest$analysis_donor_key,
      final_LEC_by_majority_vote == "LEC",
      celltypist_majority_vote == "EC8_ln"
    ) %>%
    distinct(source_cell_id, donor_key, .keep_all = TRUE)

  missing_receiver_cells <- setdiff(final_lec$source_cell_id, metadata$cell_id)
  if (length(missing_receiver_cells)) {
    stop(
      spec$analysis_id, ": ", length(missing_receiver_cells),
      " final LEC cells are absent from Step05 annotations."
    )
  }

  metadata <- metadata %>%
    mutate(
      is_final_celltypist_lec = cell_id %in% final_lec$source_cell_id,
      is_allcell_celltypist_lec = celltypist_majority_vote == "EC8_ln",
      is_author_annotated_lec = grepl(
        "lymphatic",
        coalesce(author_celltype, ""),
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ),
      excluded_nonfinal_lec_candidate =
        !is_final_celltypist_lec &
          (is_allcell_celltypist_lec | is_author_annotated_lec),
      analysis_celltype = if_else(
        is_final_celltypist_lec,
        "LEC_EC8_ln",
        celltypist_majority_vote
      ),
      analysis_celltype = if_else(
        is.na(analysis_celltype) | !nzchar(analysis_celltype),
        "Unknown",
        analysis_celltype
      )
    )

  receiver_check <- metadata %>%
    group_by(donor_key, condition) %>%
    summarise(final_LECs_recovered = sum(is_final_celltypist_lec), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(
      comparison_manifest %>%
        transmute(
          donor_key = analysis_donor_key,
          condition_manifest = condition,
          final_LECs_manifest = n_final_LECs_used
        ),
      by = "donor_key"
    )

  if (anyNA(receiver_check$final_LECs_manifest) ||
      any(receiver_check$condition != receiver_check$condition_manifest) ||
      any(receiver_check$final_LECs_recovered != receiver_check$final_LECs_manifest)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": recovered final LEC counts do not match the donor manifest.")
  }
  if (any(receiver_check$final_LECs_recovered < spec$receiver_min_cells)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": a receiver donor is below the minimum cell count.")
  }

  metadata_for_mnn <- metadata %>% filter(!excluded_nonfinal_lec_candidate)
  all_celltypes <- sort(unique(metadata_for_mnn$analysis_celltype))
  abundance <- metadata_for_mnn %>%
    count(donor_key, condition, analysis_celltype, name = "n_cells") %>%
    complete(
      donor_key = comparison_manifest$analysis_donor_key,
      analysis_celltype = all_celltypes,
      fill = list(n_cells = 0)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      comparison_manifest %>%
        transmute(donor_key = analysis_donor_key, condition_manifest = condition),
      by = "donor_key"
    ) %>%
    mutate(condition = coalesce(condition, condition_manifest)) %>%
    select(-condition_manifest)

  group_sizes <- comparison_manifest %>% count(condition, name = "n_group_donors")
  balance <- abundance %>%
    group_by(analysis_celltype, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      n_donors = n(),
      donors_with_any_cells = sum(n_cells > 0),
      qualifying_sender_donors = sum(n_cells > params$min_sender_cells_per_donor),
      qualifying_receiver_donors = sum(n_cells >= spec$receiver_min_cells),
      minimum_cells = min(n_cells),
      median_cells = median(n_cells),
      maximum_cells = max(n_cells),
      total_cells = sum(n_cells),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(group_sizes, by = "condition")

  eligibility <- balance %>%
    group_by(analysis_celltype) %>%
    summarise(
      groups_present = n_distinct(condition),
      receiver_every_donor = all(
        qualifying_receiver_donors == n_group_donors
      ),
      sender_enough_donors = all(
        qualifying_sender_donors >= params$min_donors_per_group
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      eligible = case_when(
        analysis_celltype == "Unknown" ~ FALSE,
        analysis_celltype == "LEC_EC8_ln" ~
          groups_present == 2 & receiver_every_donor,
        TRUE ~ groups_present == 2 & sender_enough_donors
      ),
      role = case_when(
        analysis_celltype == "LEC_EC8_ln" & eligible ~ "receiver",
        eligible ~ "sender",
        TRUE ~ "excluded"
      ),
      eligibility_rule = case_when(
        analysis_celltype == "LEC_EC8_ln" ~
          paste0(">=", spec$receiver_min_cells, " cells in every donor"),
        analysis_celltype == "Unknown" ~ "Unknown is never retained",
        TRUE ~ paste0(
          ">", params$min_sender_cells_per_donor,
          " cells in >=", params$min_donors_per_group, " donors per group"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(eligible), role, analysis_celltype)

  receiver_row <- eligibility %>% filter(analysis_celltype == "LEC_EC8_ln")
  if (nrow(receiver_row) != 1L || !receiver_row$eligible) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": exact final LEC receiver failed eligibility.")
  }
  senders <- eligibility %>%
    filter(eligible, role == "sender") %>%
    pull(analysis_celltype)
  if (!length(senders)) stop(spec$analysis_id, ": no sender cell type passed eligibility.")

  eligible_celltypes <- c(senders, "LEC_EC8_ln")
  retained <- metadata_for_mnn %>%
    filter(analysis_celltype %in% eligible_celltypes) %>%
    arrange(source_row_index)

  list(
    all_metadata = metadata,
    retained_metadata = retained,
    final_lec = final_lec,
    receiver_check = receiver_check,
    abundance = abundance,
    balance = balance,
    eligibility = eligibility,
    senders = senders,
    eligible_celltypes = eligible_celltypes
  )
}
```

# Direct raw-count import from AnnData CSR matrices

The function below reads only selected rows from a two-dimensional AnnData CSR
node. It validates zero-based indices, matrix shape, integer counts, and the
estimated sparse-memory requirement. Both standalone edgeR and MultiNicheNet
receive the complete raw gene universe. In particular, genes are not restricted
to the signaling prior before MultiNicheNet constructs and normalizes its donor
pseudobulks.

```{r h5ad-csr-reader}
read_h5ad_genes <- function(h5_file) {
  genes <- as.character(rhdf5::h5read(h5_file, "/var/_index"))
  if (!length(genes) || anyNA(genes) || any(!nzchar(genes))) {
    stop("Invalid /var/_index in ", h5_file)
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(genes)) stop("Duplicated gene names in ", h5_file)
  genes
}

read_h5ad_csr_rows <- function(
    h5_file,
    group_path,
    rows_zero_based,
    cell_ids,
    feature_indices_zero_based = NULL,
    feature_names = NULL,
    count_transform = "none",
    total_h5_path = NA_character_,
    normalization_target = 10000,
    inverse_integer_tolerance = 0.01,
    label = "selected cells") {
  rows_zero_based <- as.integer(rows_zero_based)
  if (length(rows_zero_based) != length(cell_ids)) {
    stop(label, ": row and cell-ID lengths differ.")
  }
  if (!length(rows_zero_based)) stop(label, ": no rows requested.")
  if (anyNA(rows_zero_based) || any(rows_zero_based < 0)) {
    stop(label, ": invalid zero-based row indices.")
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(rows_zero_based) || anyDuplicated(cell_ids)) {
    stop(label, ": row indices and cell IDs must be unique.")
  }

  attributes <- rhdf5::h5readAttributes(h5_file, group_path)
  if (!identical(as.character(attributes[["encoding-type"]]), "csr_matrix")) {
    stop(label, ": expected an AnnData csr_matrix at ", group_path)
  }
  shape <- as.numeric(attributes$shape)
  if (length(shape) != 2L || max(rows_zero_based) >= shape[1]) {
    stop(label, ": requested rows exceed the source matrix shape.")
  }

  order_rows <- order(rows_zero_based)
  rows <- rows_zero_based[order_rows]
  ordered_ids <- as.character(cell_ids)[order_rows]
  allowed_transforms <- c("none", "inverse_log1p_using_n_counts")
  if (!count_transform %in% allowed_transforms) {
    stop(label, ": unsupported count transform: ", count_transform)
  }
  selected_cell_totals <- NULL
  inverse_maximum_deviation <- 0
  if (count_transform == "inverse_log1p_using_n_counts") {
    if (is.na(total_h5_path) || !nzchar(total_h5_path) ||
        !is.finite(normalization_target) || normalization_target <= 0 ||
        !is.finite(inverse_integer_tolerance) || inverse_integer_tolerance <= 0 ||
        inverse_integer_tolerance >= 0.5) {
      stop(label, ": invalid inverse-log1p count-recovery configuration.")
    }
    all_cell_totals <- as.numeric(rhdf5::h5read(h5_file, total_h5_path))
    if (length(all_cell_totals) != shape[1] ||
        any(!is.finite(all_cell_totals)) || any(all_cell_totals <= 0)) {
      stop(label, ": invalid source cell totals at ", total_h5_path)
    }
    selected_cell_totals <- all_cell_totals[rows + 1L]
    rm(all_cell_totals)
  }
  indptr <- as.numeric(rhdf5::h5read(h5_file, paste0(group_path, "/indptr")))
  if (length(indptr) != shape[1] + 1 || any(diff(indptr) < 0)) {
    stop(label, ": invalid CSR indptr.")
  }
  selected_row_nnz <- diff(indptr)[rows + 1L]
  source_nnz <- sum(selected_row_nnz)
  estimated_gb <- estimate_sparse_gb(source_nnz)
  message(
    label, ": ", format(length(rows), big.mark = ","), " cells; ",
    format(source_nnz, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
    " source nonzeros; conservative construction estimate ",
    sprintf("%.1f GB", estimated_gb)
  )
  if (estimated_gb > params$maximum_sparse_matrix_gb) {
    stop(
      label, ": estimated sparse construction memory exceeds maximum_sparse_matrix_gb. ",
      "Run one comparison in a clean R session or increase the limit only if RAM permits."
    )
  }

  if (is.null(feature_indices_zero_based)) {
    feature_indices_zero_based <- seq.int(0L, as.integer(shape[2]) - 1L)
  }
  feature_indices_zero_based <- as.integer(feature_indices_zero_based)
  if (anyNA(feature_indices_zero_based) ||
      any(feature_indices_zero_based < 0) ||
      any(feature_indices_zero_based >= shape[2]) ||
      anyDuplicated(feature_indices_zero_based)) {
    stop(label, ": invalid feature indices.")
  }
  if (is.null(feature_names)) feature_names <- as.character(feature_indices_zero_based)
  if (length(feature_names) != length(feature_indices_zero_based)) {
    stop(label, ": feature names and indices differ in length.")
  }
  column_map <- integer(shape[2])
  column_map[feature_indices_zero_based + 1L] <- seq_along(feature_indices_zero_based)

  run_id <- cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(rows) != 1L))
  runs <- split(seq_along(rows), run_id)
  i_parts <- vector("list", length(runs))
  j_parts <- vector("list", length(runs))
  x_parts <- vector("list", length(runs))

  for (run_number in seq_along(runs)) {
    selected_positions <- runs[[run_number]]
    first_row <- rows[min(selected_positions)]
    last_row <- rows[max(selected_positions)]
    start_nnz_zero <- indptr[first_row + 1L]
    end_nnz_zero <- indptr[last_row + 2L]
    count_nnz <- end_nnz_zero - start_nnz_zero
    if (count_nnz == 0) next

    values <- as.numeric(rhdf5::h5read(
      h5_file,
      paste0(group_path, "/data"),
      start = start_nnz_zero + 1,
      count = count_nnz
    ))
    source_columns <- as.integer(rhdf5::h5read(
      h5_file,
      paste0(group_path, "/indices"),
      start = start_nnz_zero + 1,
      count = count_nnz
    ))
    mapped_columns <- column_map[source_columns + 1L]
    keep <- mapped_columns > 0L
    if (!any(keep)) next

    run_lengths <- selected_row_nnz[selected_positions]
    row_positions <- rep.int(selected_positions, run_lengths)
    kept_row_positions <- row_positions[keep]
    kept_values <- values[keep]
    if (count_transform == "inverse_log1p_using_n_counts") {
      recovered_values <- expm1(kept_values) *
        selected_cell_totals[kept_row_positions] / normalization_target
      current_deviation <- if (length(recovered_values)) {
        max(abs(recovered_values - round(recovered_values)))
      } else {
        0
      }
      inverse_maximum_deviation <- max(
        inverse_maximum_deviation,
        current_deviation
      )
      if (inverse_maximum_deviation > inverse_integer_tolerance) {
        stop(
          label, ": inverse-count deviation ",
          format(inverse_maximum_deviation, scientific = TRUE),
          " exceeds tolerance ", inverse_integer_tolerance, "."
        )
      }
      kept_values <- round(recovered_values)
    }
    i_parts[[run_number]] <- kept_row_positions
    j_parts[[run_number]] <- mapped_columns[keep]
    x_parts[[run_number]] <- kept_values
  }

  i_all <- unlist(i_parts, use.names = FALSE)
  j_all <- unlist(j_parts, use.names = FALSE)
  x_all <- unlist(x_parts, use.names = FALSE)
  rm(i_parts, j_parts, x_parts)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)

  if (length(x_all) && max(abs(x_all - round(x_all))) > 0.01) {
    stop(label, ": source values are not integer counts within tolerance 0.01.")
  }
  x_all <- round(x_all)
  cell_by_gene <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = i_all,
    j = j_all,
    x = x_all,
    dims = c(length(rows), length(feature_indices_zero_based)),
    dimnames = list(ordered_ids, feature_names),
    giveCsparse = TRUE
  )
  cell_by_gene <- Matrix::drop0(cell_by_gene)
  rm(i_all, j_all, x_all)
  counts <- as(Matrix::t(cell_by_gene), "dgCMatrix")
  rm(cell_by_gene)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)

  if (any(Matrix::colSums(counts) <= 0)) {
    stop(label, ": at least one selected cell has a zero raw library size.")
  }
  if (count_transform == "inverse_log1p_using_n_counts" &&
      length(feature_indices_zero_based) == shape[2]) {
    maximum_total_difference <- max(abs(
      as.numeric(Matrix::colSums(counts)) - round(selected_cell_totals)
    ))
    if (maximum_total_difference > 0) {
      stop(
        label, ": reconstructed raw library totals differ from ",
        total_h5_path, " by as much as ", maximum_total_difference, "."
      )
    }
    message(
      label, ": inverse-log1p raw-count recovery passed; maximum integer ",
      "deviation=", signif(inverse_maximum_deviation, 4),
      "; maximum library-total difference=", maximum_total_difference, "."
    )
  }
  counts
}
```

# Pseudobulk and edgeR functions

```{r edgeR-functions}
aggregate_counts_by_donor <- function(counts, donor_keys, donor_order) {
  donor_factor <- factor(donor_keys, levels = donor_order)
  if (anyNA(donor_factor)) stop("A cell donor is absent from donor_order.")
  design <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + donor_factor)
  colnames(design) <- donor_order
  pseudobulk <- counts %*% design
  if (!identical(colnames(pseudobulk), donor_order)) {
    stop("Pseudobulk donor columns are misaligned.")
  }
  pseudobulk
}

run_edgeR_model <- function(counts, sample_metadata, formula, contrast_string, model_name) {
  sample_metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_metadata)
  rownames(sample_metadata) <- sample_metadata$donor_key
  counts <- counts[, sample_metadata$donor_key, drop = FALSE]
  sample_metadata$group <- factor(sample_metadata$group)
  if ("sex" %in% names(sample_metadata)) sample_metadata$sex <- factor(sample_metadata$sex)

  design <- model.matrix(formula, data = sample_metadata)
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
  if (qr(design)$rank < ncol(design)) {
    return(list(status = "not_estimable_rank_deficient", model = model_name))
  }

  y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts, samples = sample_metadata)
  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(y, design = design)
  if (!any(keep)) stop(model_name, ": filterByExpr retained no genes.")
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
  y <- edgeR::estimateDisp(y, design, robust = TRUE)
  fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(y, design, robust = TRUE)
  contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_string, levels = design)
  test <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast)
  result <- edgeR::topTags(test, n = Inf, sort.by = "none")$table %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(
      model = model_name,
      significant_primary = FDR <= params$fdr_threshold &
        abs(logFC) >= params$min_abs_logfc,
      direction = case_when(
        significant_primary & logFC > 0 ~ "up_in_disease",
        significant_primary & logFC < 0 ~ "down_in_disease",
        TRUE ~ "not_significant"
      )
    )
  sample_qc <- tibble(
    donor_key = colnames(y),
    group = as.character(sample_metadata[colnames(y), "group"]),
    raw_library_size = y$samples$lib.size,
    TMM_normalization_factor = y$samples$norm.factors,
    effective_library_size = y$samples$lib.size * y$samples$norm.factors
  )
  list(
    status = "fitted",
    model = model_name,
    result = result,
    sample_qc = sample_qc,
    y = y,
    fit = fit,
    design = design
  )
}

save_edgeR_diagnostics <- function(edge_result, figure_dir, prefix, title) {
  if (!identical(edge_result$status, "fitted")) return(invisible(NULL))
  png(file.path(figure_dir, paste0(prefix, "_edgeR_MDS.png")), 2100, 1800, res = 300)
  colors <- c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")[factor(edge_result$sample_qc$group)]
  limma::plotMDS(
    edge_result$y,
    labels = edge_result$sample_qc$donor_key,
    col = colors,
    main = paste0(title, ": donor pseudobulk MDS")
  )
  dev.off()

  png(file.path(figure_dir, paste0(prefix, "_edgeR_BCV.png")), 2100, 1800, res = 300)
  edgeR::plotBCV(edge_result$y, main = paste0(title, ": biological variation"))
  dev.off()

  volcano_data <- edge_result$result %>%
    mutate(neg_log10_FDR = -log10(pmax(FDR, .Machine$double.xmin)))
  volcano <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(logFC, neg_log10_FDR, color = direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-params$min_abs_logfc, params$min_abs_logfc), linetype = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(params$fdr_threshold), linetype = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      up_in_disease = "#D55E00",
      down_in_disease = "#0072B2",
      not_significant = "grey75"
    )) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(title, ": donor-pseudobulk edgeR"),
      x = "log2 fold-change (disease minus NF)",
      y = "-log10 FDR",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
  ggsave(
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0(prefix, "_edgeR_volcano.png")),
    volcano,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```
