# MultiNicheNet and figure functions

```{r multinichenet-functions}
run_multinichenet_comparison <- function(
    counts,
    cell_metadata,
    spec,
    senders,
    celltype_name_map) {
  mnn_meta <- cell_metadata %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id_mnn = make.names(donor_key),
      group_mnn = make.names(condition),
      celltype_mnn = celltype_name_map$celltype_mnn[
        match(analysis_celltype, celltype_name_map$analysis_celltype)
      ]
    )
  if (anyNA(mnn_meta[, c("sample_id_mnn", "group_mnn", "celltype_mnn")])) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": failed to create MultiNicheNet metadata.")
  }
  sample_group <- distinct(mnn_meta, sample_id_mnn, group_mnn)
  if (anyDuplicated(sample_group$sample_id_mnn)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": one donor maps to multiple MultiNicheNet groups.")
  }

  mnn_sce <- SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = counts),
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(mnn_meta, row.names = colnames(counts))
  )
  mnn_sce <- multinichenetr::alias_to_symbol_SCE(mnn_sce, "human") %>%
    multinichenetr::makenames_SCE()

  receiver_oi <- celltype_name_map$celltype_mnn[
    celltype_name_map$analysis_celltype == "LEC_EC8_ln"
  ]
  senders_oi <- celltype_name_map$celltype_mnn[
    celltype_name_map$analysis_celltype %in% senders
  ]
  disease_group <- make.names(spec$disease)
  reference_group <- make.names(spec$reference)
  forward <- paste0(disease_group, "-", reference_group)
  reverse <- paste0(reference_group, "-", disease_group)
  contrasts_oi <- paste0("'", forward, "','", reverse, "'")
  contrast_tbl <- tibble(
    contrast = c(forward, reverse),
    group = c(disease_group, reference_group)
  )

  overlap_qc <- tibble(
    metric = c(
      "input_genes", "ligand_target_background_overlap",
      "ligands_in_network", "receptors_in_network", "eligible_sender_celltypes"
    ),
    value = c(
      nrow(mnn_sce),
      length(intersect(rownames(mnn_sce), rownames(ligand_target_matrix))),
      length(intersect(rownames(mnn_sce), unique(lr_network$ligand))),
      length(intersect(rownames(mnn_sce), unique(lr_network$receptor))),
      length(senders_oi)
    )
  )

  result <- multinichenetr::multi_nichenet_analysis(
    sce = mnn_sce,
    celltype_id = "celltype_mnn",
    sample_id = "sample_id_mnn",
    group_id = "group_mnn",
    batches = NA,
    covariates = NA,
    lr_network = lr_network,
    ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
    contrasts_oi = contrasts_oi,
    contrast_tbl = contrast_tbl,
    senders_oi = senders_oi,
    receivers_oi = receiver_oi,
    min_cells = as.double(params$min_sender_cells_per_donor),
    fraction_cutoff = as.double(params$expressed_cell_fraction),
    min_sample_prop = as.double(params$expressed_sample_fraction),
    scenario = "regular",
    ligand_activity_down = FALSE,
    logFC_threshold = as.double(params$min_abs_logfc),
    p_val_threshold = as.double(params$mnn_p_value_threshold),
    p_val_adj = isTRUE(params$mnn_use_adjusted_p),
    empirical_pval = FALSE,
    top_n_target = as.double(params$top_n_targets),
    n.cores = as.double(max(1L, as.integer(params$n_cores))),
    verbose = TRUE
  )

  list(
    output = result,
    metadata = mnn_meta,
    overlap_qc = overlap_qc,
    receiver_oi = receiver_oi,
    senders_oi = senders_oi,
    contrasts = contrast_tbl
  )
}

save_prioritization_plot <- function(mnn_output, spec, figure_dir) {
  priorities <- as.data.frame(
    mnn_output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl
  )
  required <- c(
    "contrast", "group", "sender", "receiver", "ligand", "receptor",
    "prioritization_score"
  )
  if (!all(required %in% names(priorities))) {
    empty_figure(
      file.path(figure_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_top_interactions.png"),
      spec$analysis_id,
      "Unexpected MultiNicheNet group-prioritization schema."
    )
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  disease_group <- make.names(spec$disease)
  plot_data <- priorities %>%
    filter(group == disease_group, is.finite(prioritization_score)) %>%
    mutate(interaction = paste0(sender, ": ", ligand, "–", receptor)) %>%
    slice_max(prioritization_score, n = 25, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(prioritization_score) %>%
    mutate(interaction = factor(interaction, levels = interaction))
  path <- file.path(figure_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_top_interactions.png")
  if (!nrow(plot_data)) {
    empty_figure(path, spec$analysis_id, "No finite disease-group prioritization scores.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(interaction, prioritization_score, fill = sender)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(spec$disease, " versus ", spec$reference, ": top MultiNicheNet interactions"),
      x = NULL,
      y = "MultiNicheNet prioritization score"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10)
  ggsave(path, plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}

save_tile_heatmap <- function(
    data, y_order, title, x_name, legend_title, high_color,
    path, width = 8, height = 6) {
  if (!nrow(data)) {
    empty_figure(path, title, "No links passed the exploratory visualization rule.", width, height)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  x_order <- data %>%
    group_by(x_label) %>%
    summarise(max_value = max(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(max_value)) %>%
    pull(x_label)
  plot_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      x_label = factor(x_label, levels = x_order),
      y_label = factor(y_label, levels = rev(y_order))
    )
  plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x_label, y_label, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "whitesmoke", high = high_color) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, x = x_name, y = "Prioritized ligands", fill = legend_title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    )
  ggsave(path, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
}

save_chord_figure <- function(
    links, ligand_sources, title, target_label, target_color, path) {
  chord_links <- links %>%
    filter(is.finite(weight), weight > 0) %>%
    group_by(ligand) %>%
    slice_max(weight, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
  if (nrow(chord_links) > 1L) {
    cutoff <- as.numeric(quantile(chord_links$weight, 0.40, na.rm = TRUE))
    chord_links <- chord_links %>% filter(weight >= cutoff)
  }
  if (!nrow(chord_links)) {
    empty_figure(path, title, "No links passed the exploratory visualization rule.", 8, 8)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  source_key <- ligand_sources %>%
    distinct(ligand, ligand_type) %>%
    filter(ligand %in% chord_links$ligand)
  missing_sources <- setdiff(unique(chord_links$ligand), source_key$ligand)
  if (length(missing_sources)) {
    source_key <- bind_rows(
      source_key,
      tibble(ligand = missing_sources, ligand_type = "General")
    )
  }
  source_levels <- sort(unique(source_key$ligand_type))
  source_colors <- setNames(
    grDevices::hcl.colors(max(1L, length(source_levels)), "Dark 3"),
    source_levels
  )
  chord_input <- chord_links %>%
    transmute(
      from = paste0("Ligand: ", ligand),
      to = paste0(target_label, ": ", target),
      value = weight,
      ligand
    )
  ligand_colors <- setNames(
    source_colors[source_key$ligand_type[match(chord_links$ligand, source_key$ligand)]],
    paste0("Ligand: ", chord_links$ligand)
  )
  target_nodes <- unique(chord_input$to)
  grid_colors <- c(
    ligand_colors[!duplicated(names(ligand_colors))],
    setNames(rep(target_color, length(target_nodes)), target_nodes)
  )

  png(path, width = 2400, height = 2400, res = 300)
  tryCatch(
    {
      par(mar = c(1, 1, 6, 1), xpd = NA)
      circlize::circos.clear()
      circlize::circos.par(
        start.degree = 90,
        track.margin = c(0.01, 0.01),
        cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0)
      )
      circlize::chordDiagram(
        chord_input[, c("from", "to", "value")],
        grid.col = grid_colors,
        transparency = 0.35,
        annotationTrack = "grid",
        preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.12)
      )
      circlize::circos.trackPlotRegion(
        track.index = 1,
        bg.border = NA,
        panel.fun = function(x, y) {
          sector <- circlize::get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
          label <- sub("^[^:]+: ", "", sector)
          xlim <- circlize::get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
          ylim <- circlize::get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
          circlize::circos.text(
            mean(xlim), ylim[1], label,
            facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE,
            adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.45
          )
        }
      )
      legend(
        "topleft",
        legend = c(source_levels, target_label),
        fill = c(unname(source_colors), target_color),
        border = NA,
        bty = "n",
        cex = 0.65
      )
      mtext(title, side = 3, line = 3, cex = 0.85, font = 2)
    },
    finally = {
      circlize::circos.clear()
      dev.off()
    }
  )
}

make_sydney_figure_suite <- function(
    edge_result,
    receiver_pseudobulk,
    donor_metadata,
    mnn_output,
    celltype_name_map,
    spec,
    output_dir) {
  figure_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "figures", "Sydney_equivalent")
  table_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")
  dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!identical(edge_result$status, "fitted")) return(invisible(NULL))

  network_symbol <- function(genes) {
    converted <- nichenetr::convert_alias_to_symbols(
      genes, organism = "human", verbose = FALSE
    )
    replace <- is.na(converted) | !nzchar(converted)
    converted[replace] <- genes[replace]
    make.names(converted)
  }

  de <- edge_result$result %>%
    mutate(gene_network = network_symbol(gene)) %>%
    arrange(FDR) %>%
    distinct(gene_network, .keep_all = TRUE)
  ref_columns <- match(
    donor_metadata$donor_key[donor_metadata$group == spec$reference],
    colnames(receiver_pseudobulk)
  )
  disease_columns <- match(
    donor_metadata$donor_key[donor_metadata$group == spec$disease],
    colnames(receiver_pseudobulk)
  )
  detected <-
    Matrix::rowMeans(receiver_pseudobulk[, ref_columns, drop = FALSE] > 0) >=
      params$expressed_sample_fraction &
    Matrix::rowMeans(receiver_pseudobulk[, disease_columns, drop = FALSE] > 0) >=
      params$expressed_sample_fraction
  background <- intersect(
    network_symbol(rownames(receiver_pseudobulk)[detected]),
    rownames(ligand_target_matrix)
  )
  genesets <- list(
    upregulated = de %>%
      filter(
        FDR <= params$sydney_visual_fdr,
        logFC >= params$min_abs_logfc,
        gene_network %in% background
      ) %>%
      slice_head(n = as.integer(params$sydney_visual_top_genes)) %>%
      pull(gene_network),
    downregulated = de %>%
      filter(
        FDR <= params$sydney_visual_fdr,
        logFC <= -params$min_abs_logfc,
        gene_network %in% background
      ) %>%
      slice_head(n = as.integer(params$sydney_visual_top_genes)) %>%
      pull(gene_network)
  )

  priorities <- as.data.frame(
    mnn_output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl
  )
  expressed_receptors <- intersect(unique(lr_network$receptor), background)
  potential_ligands <- lr_network %>%
    filter(
      receptor %in% expressed_receptors,
      ligand %in% unique(priorities$ligand),
      ligand %in% colnames(ligand_target_matrix)
    ) %>%
    pull(ligand) %>%
    unique()
  lr_for_links <- lr_network %>%
    transmute(from = ligand, to = receptor) %>%
    distinct()

  run_direction <- function(geneset) {
    if (length(geneset) < 2L || !length(potential_ligands)) {
      return(list(
        activities = tibble(),
        top_ligands = character(),
        ligand_target_links = tibble(),
        ligand_receptor_links = tibble()
      ))
    }
    activities <- nichenetr::predict_ligand_activities(
      geneset = geneset,
      background_expressed_genes = background,
      ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
      potential_ligands = potential_ligands
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(aupr_corrected))
    top_ligands <- head(
      activities$test_ligand,
      as.integer(params$sydney_visual_top_ligands)
    )
    if (!length(top_ligands)) {
      return(list(
        activities = activities,
        top_ligands = character(),
        ligand_target_links = tibble(),
        ligand_receptor_links = tibble()
      ))
    }
    target_links <- bind_rows(lapply(
      top_ligands,
      nichenetr::get_weighted_ligand_target_links,
      geneset = geneset,
      ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix,
      n = 50
    )) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na(ligand, target, weight)
    receptor_links <- nichenetr::get_weighted_ligand_receptor_links(
      top_ligands,
      expressed_receptors,
      lr_for_links,
      weighted_networks$lr_sig
    ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na(from, to, weight)
    list(
      activities = activities,
      top_ligands = top_ligands,
      ligand_target_links = target_links,
      ligand_receptor_links = receptor_links
    )
  }

  results <- lapply(genesets, run_direction)
  source_group <- c(upregulated = make.names(spec$disease), downregulated = make.names(spec$reference))
  all_figure_rows <- list()

  for (direction in names(results)) {
    result <- results[[direction]]
    direction_short <- if (direction == "upregulated") "up" else "down"
    title_stub <- paste0(spec$disease, "-", direction, " LEC genes")
    source_scores <- priorities %>%
      filter(group == source_group[[direction]], ligand %in% result$top_ligands) %>%
      group_by(ligand, sender) %>%
      summarise(
        source_score = if (all(is.na(scaled_pb_ligand))) -Inf else
          max(scaled_pb_ligand, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      group_by(ligand) %>%
      slice_max(source_score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      left_join(celltype_name_map, by = c("sender" = "celltype_mnn")) %>%
      transmute(ligand, ligand_type = coalesce(analysis_celltype, sender))
    sources <- tibble(ligand = result$top_ligands) %>%
      left_join(source_scores, by = "ligand") %>%
      mutate(ligand_type = coalesce(ligand_type, "General"))

    paths <- c(
      ligand_activity = file.path(figure_dir, paste0("12_ligand_activity_", direction_short, ".png")),
      ligand_target = file.path(figure_dir, paste0("12_ligand_target_", direction_short, ".png")),
      ligand_receptor = file.path(figure_dir, paste0("12_ligand_receptor_", direction_short, ".png")),
      ligand_target_chord = file.path(figure_dir, paste0("12_ligand_target_chord_", direction_short, ".png")),
      ligand_receptor_chord = file.path(figure_dir, paste0("12_ligand_receptor_chord_", direction_short, ".png"))
    )

    activity_data <- result$activities %>%
      filter(test_ligand %in% result$top_ligands) %>%
      transmute(x_label = "Ligand activity", y_label = test_ligand, value = aupr_corrected)
    save_tile_heatmap(
      activity_data, result$top_ligands,
      paste0("Predicted upstream ligands of ", title_stub),
      "Ligand activity", "AUPR corrected", "darkorange",
      paths[["ligand_activity"]], 6, 6
    )
    target_heatmap <- result$ligand_target_links %>%
      transmute(x_label = target, y_label = ligand, value = weight)
    save_tile_heatmap(
      target_heatmap, result$top_ligands,
      paste0("Predicted ligand-target regulatory potential for ", title_stub),
      "Predicted target genes", "Regulatory potential", "purple",
      paths[["ligand_target"]], 10, 6
    )
    receptor_links <- result$ligand_receptor_links %>%
      transmute(ligand = from, target = to, weight) %>%
      distinct(ligand, target, .keep_all = TRUE)
    receptor_heatmap <- receptor_links %>%
      transmute(x_label = target, y_label = ligand, value = weight)
    save_tile_heatmap(
      receptor_heatmap, result$top_ligands,
      paste0("Predicted ligand-receptor interactions for ", title_stub),
      "Receptors", "Prior interaction potential", "mediumvioletred",
      paths[["ligand_receptor"]], 8, 6
    )
    save_chord_figure(
      result$ligand_target_links, sources,
      paste0("Predicted cellular sources associated with ", title_stub),
      "LEC target", "#999999", paths[["ligand_target_chord"]]
    )
    save_chord_figure(
      receptor_links, sources,
      paste0("Predicted ligand-receptor interactions associated with ", title_stub),
      "LEC receptor", "#E41A1C", paths[["ligand_receptor_chord"]]
    )

    write_csv_safe(
      tibble(direction = direction, gene = genesets[[direction]]),
      file.path(table_dir, paste0("12_Sydney_geneset_", direction_short, ".csv"))
    )
    write_csv_safe(
      result$activities %>% mutate(direction = direction),
      file.path(table_dir, paste0("12_Sydney_ligand_activities_", direction_short, ".csv"))
    )
    write_csv_safe(
      result$ligand_target_links %>% mutate(direction = direction),
      file.path(table_dir, paste0("12_Sydney_ligand_target_links_", direction_short, ".csv"))
    )
    write_csv_safe(
      result$ligand_receptor_links %>% mutate(direction = direction),
      file.path(table_dir, paste0("12_Sydney_ligand_receptor_links_", direction_short, ".csv"))
    )
    all_figure_rows[[direction]] <- tibble(
      direction = direction,
      figure_type = names(paths),
      path = unname(paths),
      exists = file.exists(unname(paths)),
      bytes = as.numeric(file.info(unname(paths))$size)
    )
  }
  write_csv_safe(
    bind_rows(all_figure_rows),
    file.path(output_dir, "12_Sydney_equivalent_figure_manifest.csv")
  )
}
```

# Execute the selected within-dataset comparisons

Each comparison is completed and saved before the next comparison begins. The
full cell-level sparse matrix is removed after every run. This is intentional:
dataset01 is much larger than the aging cohort and should not coexist in memory
with dataset08.

```{r run-comparisons, cache=FALSE}
final_lec_all <- read_final_lec_metadata()
run_summaries <- list()

for (analysis_index in seq_len(nrow(comparison_specs))) {
  spec <- comparison_specs[analysis_index, ]
  message("\n===== ", spec$analysis_id, " =====")

  comparison_dir <- file.path(output_root, spec$analysis_id)
  tables_dir <- file.path(comparison_dir, "tables")
  figures_dir <- file.path(comparison_dir, "figures")
  completed_summary <- load_completed_summary(spec, comparison_dir)
  if (!is.null(completed_summary)) {
    message(
      "Reusing completed checkpoint for ", spec$analysis_id,
      "; raw counts, edgeR, MultiNicheNet, and figures will not rerun."
    )
    run_summaries[[spec$analysis_id]] <- completed_summary
    next
  }
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  comparison_manifest <- donor_manifest_all %>%
    filter(
      dataset_folder == spec$dataset_folder,
      condition %in% c(spec$reference, spec$disease),
      n_final_LECs_used >= spec$receiver_min_cells
    ) %>%
    arrange(factor(condition, levels = c(spec$reference, spec$disease)), analysis_donor_key)

  group_counts <- comparison_manifest %>% count(condition, name = "n_donors")
  if (nrow(group_counts) != 2L ||
      any(group_counts$n_donors < params$min_donors_per_group)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": insufficient retained donors in one or both groups.")
  }
  donor_order <- comparison_manifest$analysis_donor_key

  prepared <- prepare_comparison_metadata(
    spec,
    comparison_manifest,
    final_lec_all
  )

  write_csv_safe(comparison_manifest, file.path(tables_dir, "12_selected_donors.csv"))
  write_csv_safe(prepared$receiver_check, file.path(tables_dir, "12_receiver_count_check.csv"))
  write_csv_safe(prepared$abundance, file.path(tables_dir, "12_celltype_by_donor_abundance.csv"))
  write_csv_safe(prepared$balance, file.path(tables_dir, "12_celltype_group_balance.csv"))
  write_csv_safe(prepared$eligibility, file.path(tables_dir, "12_celltype_eligibility.csv"))
  write_csv_safe(
    prepared$all_metadata %>% filter(excluded_nonfinal_lec_candidate),
    file.path(tables_dir, "12_excluded_nonfinal_LEC_candidates.csv.gz")
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    prepared$retained_metadata,
    file.path(tables_dir, "12_selected_cell_metadata.csv.gz")
  )

  celltype_name_map <- tibble(
    analysis_celltype = prepared$eligible_celltypes,
    celltype_mnn = make.names(prepared$eligible_celltypes)
  )
  if (anyDuplicated(celltype_name_map$celltype_mnn)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": cell-type labels collide after make.names().")
  }
  write_csv_safe(celltype_name_map, file.path(tables_dir, "12_celltype_name_map.csv"))

  validation_summary <- tibble(
    analysis_id = spec$analysis_id,
    dataset_folder = spec$dataset_folder,
    reference = spec$reference,
    disease = spec$disease,
    analysis_tier = spec$analysis_tier,
    receiver_min_cells = spec$receiver_min_cells,
    n_reference_donors = sum(comparison_manifest$condition == spec$reference),
    n_disease_donors = sum(comparison_manifest$condition == spec$disease),
    n_selected_cells = nrow(prepared$retained_metadata),
    n_receiver_cells = nrow(prepared$final_lec),
    n_eligible_senders = length(prepared$senders),
    source_h5ad = spec$source_h5ad,
    count_h5_path = spec$count_h5_path,
    validation_status = "passed"
  )
  write_csv_safe(validation_summary, file.path(comparison_dir, "12_validation_summary.csv"))

  if (isTRUE(params$validate_only)) {
    run_summaries[[spec$analysis_id]] <- validation_summary %>%
      mutate(status = "validation_only_passed")
    rm(prepared)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
    next
  }

  source_genes <- read_h5ad_genes(spec$source_h5ad)
  # Receiver counts retain the complete raw gene universe for standalone edgeR.
  receiver_metadata <- prepared$retained_metadata %>%
    filter(analysis_celltype == "LEC_EC8_ln") %>%
    arrange(source_row_index)
  receiver_counts <- read_h5ad_csr_rows(
    spec$source_h5ad,
    spec$count_h5_path,
    receiver_metadata$source_row_index,
    receiver_metadata$cell_id,
    feature_names = source_genes,
    count_transform = spec$count_transform,
    total_h5_path = spec$count_total_h5_path,
    label = paste0(spec$analysis_id, " final LEC receiver")
  )
  if (!identical(colnames(receiver_counts), receiver_metadata$cell_id)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": receiver count columns and metadata are misaligned.")
  }

  receiver_pseudobulk <- aggregate_counts_by_donor(
    receiver_counts,
    receiver_metadata$donor_key,
    donor_order
  )
  receiver_library_sizes <- Matrix::colSums(receiver_pseudobulk)
  if (any(receiver_library_sizes <= 0)) {
    stop(spec$analysis_id, ": a receiver pseudobulk has zero library size.")
  }
  receiver_log1p_cpm <- log1p(
    sweep(
      as.matrix(receiver_pseudobulk),
      2,
      receiver_library_sizes,
      "/"
    ) * 1e6
  )

  donor_metadata <- comparison_manifest %>%
    transmute(
      donor_key = analysis_donor_key,
      group = condition,
      age = age,
      age_scaled = as.numeric(scale(age)),
      sex = sex,
      n_final_LECs = n_final_LECs_used,
      n_source_samples = n_final_LEC_samples_contributing
    )

  group_summary <- tibble(gene = rownames(receiver_log1p_cpm))
  group_summary[[paste0(spec$reference, "_mean_log1p_CPM_equal_donor")]] <-
    rowMeans(receiver_log1p_cpm[, donor_metadata$group == spec$reference, drop = FALSE])
  group_summary[[paste0(spec$disease, "_mean_log1p_CPM_equal_donor")]] <-
    rowMeans(receiver_log1p_cpm[, donor_metadata$group == spec$disease, drop = FALSE])
  group_summary[[paste0(spec$disease, "_minus_", spec$reference)]] <-
    group_summary[[paste0(spec$disease, "_mean_log1p_CPM_equal_donor")]] -
    group_summary[[paste0(spec$reference, "_mean_log1p_CPM_equal_donor")]]

  saveRDS(
    receiver_pseudobulk,
    file.path(tables_dir, "12_LEC_raw_count_pseudobulk_gene_by_donor.rds")
  )
  saveRDS(
    receiver_log1p_cpm,
    file.path(tables_dir, "12_LEC_log1p_CPM_pseudobulk_gene_by_donor.rds")
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    data.frame(gene = rownames(receiver_pseudobulk), as.matrix(receiver_pseudobulk), check.names = FALSE),
    file.path(tables_dir, "12_LEC_pseudobulk_raw_counts_by_donor.csv.gz")
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    data.frame(gene = rownames(receiver_log1p_cpm), receiver_log1p_cpm, check.names = FALSE),
    file.path(tables_dir, "12_LEC_pseudobulk_log1p_CPM_by_donor.csv.gz")
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    group_summary,
    file.path(tables_dir, "12_LEC_equal_donor_group_mean_log1p_CPM.csv.gz")
  )

  primary_contrast <- paste0("group", make.names(spec$disease), "-group", make.names(spec$reference))
  edge_primary <- run_edgeR_model(
    receiver_pseudobulk,
    donor_metadata,
    ~ 0 + group,
    primary_contrast,
    "primary_unadjusted_donor_pseudobulk"
  )
  write_csv_safe(edge_primary$result, file.path(tables_dir, "12_edgeR_primary_all_genes.csv.gz"))
  write_csv_safe(edge_primary$sample_qc, file.path(tables_dir, "12_edgeR_TMM_sample_QC.csv"))
  save_edgeR_diagnostics(
    edge_primary,
    figures_dir,
    "12_primary",
    paste0(spec$disease, " versus ", spec$reference)
  )

  sensitivity_status <- "not_applicable"
  if (spec$dataset_folder == "dataset01") {
    if (all(!is.na(donor_metadata$age_scaled)) && all(!is.na(donor_metadata$sex))) {
      edge_adjusted <- run_edgeR_model(
        receiver_pseudobulk,
        donor_metadata,
        ~ 0 + group + age_scaled + sex,
        primary_contrast,
        "dataset01_age_sex_adjusted_sensitivity"
      )
      sensitivity_status <- edge_adjusted$status
      if (identical(edge_adjusted$status, "fitted")) {
        write_csv_safe(
          edge_adjusted$result,
          file.path(tables_dir, "12_edgeR_dataset01_age_sex_adjusted_sensitivity.csv.gz")
        )
        write_csv_safe(
          edge_adjusted$sample_qc,
          file.path(tables_dir, "12_edgeR_dataset01_age_sex_TMM_sample_QC.csv")
        )
      } else {
        write_text_safe(
          paste0("Dataset01 age/Sex sensitivity status: ", edge_adjusted$status),
          file.path(tables_dir, "12_edgeR_dataset01_age_sex_sensitivity_status.txt")
        )
      }
      rm(edge_adjusted)
    } else {
      sensitivity_status <- "not_run_missing_covariates"
    }
  }

  mnn_result <- NULL
  mnn_counts <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(params$run_multinichenet)) {
    mnn_metadata <- prepared$retained_metadata %>% arrange(source_row_index)
    mnn_counts <- read_h5ad_csr_rows(
      spec$source_h5ad,
      spec$count_h5_path,
      mnn_metadata$source_row_index,
      mnn_metadata$cell_id,
      feature_names = source_genes,
      count_transform = spec$count_transform,
      total_h5_path = spec$count_total_h5_path,
      label = paste0(spec$analysis_id, " eligible sender/receiver cells")
    )
    if (!identical(colnames(mnn_counts), mnn_metadata$cell_id)) {
      stop(spec$analysis_id, ": MultiNicheNet count columns and metadata are misaligned.")
    }

    input_cell_counts <- mnn_metadata %>%
      mutate(
        sample_id_mnn = make.names(donor_key),
        group_mnn = make.names(condition),
        celltype_mnn = celltype_name_map$celltype_mnn[
          match(analysis_celltype, celltype_name_map$analysis_celltype)
        ]
      ) %>%
      count(sample_id_mnn, group_mnn, celltype_mnn, name = "n_cells")
    write_csv_safe(input_cell_counts, file.path(tables_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_input_cell_counts.csv"))

    mnn_result <- run_multinichenet_comparison(
      mnn_counts,
      mnn_metadata,
      spec,
      prepared$senders,
      celltype_name_map
    )
    saveRDS(mnn_result$output, file.path(comparison_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_output.rds"))
    write_csv_safe(mnn_result$overlap_qc, file.path(tables_dir, "12_NicheNet_network_overlap_QC.csv"))
    write_csv_safe(mnn_result$contrasts, file.path(tables_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_contrasts.csv"))
    write_if_data_frame(
      mnn_result$output$celltype_info$pb_df,
      file.path(tables_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_normalized_pseudobulk_by_sample.csv")
    )
    write_if_data_frame(
      mnn_result$output$celltype_info$pb_df_group,
      file.path(tables_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_normalized_pseudobulk_by_group.csv")
    )
    write_if_data_frame(
      mnn_result$output$celltype_de,
      file.path(tables_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_celltype_DE.csv")
    )
    write_if_data_frame(
      mnn_result$output$ligand_activities_targets_DEgenes$ligand_activities,
      file.path(tables_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_ligand_activities.csv")
    )
    write_if_data_frame(
      mnn_result$output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl,
      file.path(tables_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_group_prioritization.csv")
    )
    write_if_data_frame(
      mnn_result$output$prioritization_tables$sample_prioritization_tbl,
      file.path(tables_dir, "12_MultiNicheNet_sample_prioritization.csv")
    )
    save_prioritization_plot(mnn_result$output, spec, figures_dir)

    if (isTRUE(params$make_sydney_equivalent_figures)) {
      make_sydney_figure_suite(
        edge_primary,
        receiver_pseudobulk,
        donor_metadata,
        mnn_result$output,
        celltype_name_map,
        spec,
        comparison_dir
      )
    }
  }

  method_notes <- c(
    paste0("Disease MultiNicheNet analysis: ", spec$analysis_id),
    "",
    "Biological replication",
    "----------------------",
    paste0("Reference: ", spec$reference, "; disease: ", spec$disease, "."),
    paste0("Donors: ", sum(donor_metadata$group == spec$reference), " reference and ",
           sum(donor_metadata$group == spec$disease), " disease."),
    "analysis_donor_key (dataset::donor) is the MultiNicheNet sample ID.",
    "Multiple specimens from the same person are combined before donor-level inference.",
    "No donor is discarded solely to force equal group sizes.",
    "",
    "Counts and normalization",
    "------------------------",
    paste0("Raw source: ", spec$source_h5ad, " at ", spec$count_h5_path, "."),
    if (spec$count_transform == "none") {
      "The selected source node contains validated integer counts."
    } else {
      paste0(
        "Dataset11 /X is log1p library-normalized; raw integer counts are reconstructed as ",
        "round(expm1(X) * ", spec$count_total_h5_path,
        " / 10000), with integer-deviation and exact cell-total validation."
      )
    },
    "Step03 log-normalized expression is never supplied to edgeR as if it were counts.",
    "MultiNicheNet receives the complete raw gene matrix; it is not prefiltered to NicheNet-prior genes before donor pseudobulk normalization.",
    "Descriptive donor profiles are log1p(raw donor pseudobulk / raw donor library size * 1e6).",
    "Descriptive group profiles are unweighted donor means and are not hypothesis tests.",
    "edgeR receives raw donor sums; filterByExpr removes low-information genes; TMM supplies effective-library-size offsets.",
    "TMM is library/composition normalization, not a donor weight or a batch correction.",
    "",
    "MultiNicheNet",
    "-------------",
    paste0("Receiver: exact final EC8_ln LECs, >=", spec$receiver_min_cells, " per donor."),
    paste0("Senders: >", params$min_sender_cells_per_donor, " cells in >=",
           params$min_donors_per_group, " donors per group."),
    "The primary MultiNicheNet model is unadjusted and remains within one dataset.",
    "Non-final EC8_ln or author-annotated lymphatic endothelial candidates cannot be sender cells.",
    "Prioritized interactions are hypotheses, not proof of physical signaling or causality.",
    "",
    "Sensitivity and limitations",
    "---------------------------",
    if (spec$dataset_folder == "dataset01") {
      paste0("Dataset01 age/Sex edgeR sensitivity status: ", sensitivity_status, ".")
    } else {
      "No covariate-adjusted edgeR model is designated for this dataset."
    },
    if (spec$dataset_folder == "dataset08") {
      "Dataset08 has only four NF donors and missing age/Sex metadata; interpret donor-level uncertainty explicitly."
    } else if (spec$dataset_folder == "dataset11") {
      paste0(
        "Dataset11 analysis tier: ", spec$analysis_tier,
        ". This is an exploratory within-dataset sensitivity because NF receiver depth is low."
      )
    } else {
      "Dataset01 age and Sex are available, but adjusted results remain a sensitivity analysis."
    },
    if (spec$dataset_folder == "dataset11") {
      "The same receiver-cell cutoff is applied to HFpEF and NF. Interpret a signal as more credible only when direction and prioritization agree between the >=10 and >=15 runs."
    } else {
      "The conservative dataset11 >=25 branch remains non-testable because no NF donor passes that threshold."
    },
    "No NF donors from another dataset are substituted in any analysis."
  )
  write_text_safe(method_notes, file.path(comparison_dir, "12_method_and_interpretation_notes.txt"))

  run_config <- list(
    analysis_id = spec$analysis_id,
    dataset_folder = spec$dataset_folder,
    reference = spec$reference,
    disease = spec$disease,
    analysis_tier = spec$analysis_tier,
    donor_key = "analysis_donor_key",
    source_h5ad = spec$source_h5ad,
    count_h5_path = spec$count_h5_path,
    n_reference_donors = sum(donor_metadata$group == spec$reference),
    n_disease_donors = sum(donor_metadata$group == spec$disease),
    min_receiver_cells_per_donor = spec$receiver_min_cells,
    min_sender_cells_per_donor = params$min_sender_cells_per_donor,
    min_donors_per_group = params$min_donors_per_group,
    descriptive_normalization = "log1p(raw_donor_pseudobulk/raw_library_size*1e6)",
    edgeR_input = "raw_integer_donor_pseudobulk_counts",
    count_transform = spec$count_transform,
    count_total_h5_path = spec$count_total_h5_path,
    edgeR_normalization = "filterByExpr_then_TMM_effective_library_size_offsets",
    edgeR_primary_model = "condition_only_robust_quasi_likelihood",
    multinichenet_sample_id = "dataset_namespaced_donor",
    multinichenet_gene_input = "complete_raw_gene_universe_before_internal_pseudobulk_TMM",
    source_row_index_resolution = "Step05_cell_id_to_Step03_obs_index_to_original_source_row_index",
    multinichenet_version = as.character(packageVersion("multinichenetr")),
    run_multinichenet = isTRUE(params$run_multinichenet),
    make_sydney_equivalent_figures = isTRUE(params$make_sydney_equivalent_figures),
    timestamp = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")
  )
  jsonlite::write_json(
    run_config,
    file.path(comparison_dir, "12_run_config.json"),
    pretty = TRUE,
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    na = "null"
  )

  run_summary <- validation_summary %>%
    mutate(
      n_edgeR_genes_tested = nrow(edge_primary$result),
      n_edgeR_FDR05_logFC025 = sum(edge_primary$result$significant_primary),
      dataset01_age_sex_sensitivity = sensitivity_status,
      multinichenet_completed = !is.null(mnn_result),
      status = "completed",
      execution_action = "computed_this_render"
    )
  write_csv_safe(run_summary, file.path(comparison_dir, "12_run_summary.csv"))
  run_summaries[[spec$analysis_id]] <- run_summary

  rm(
    receiver_counts, receiver_pseudobulk, receiver_log1p_cpm,
    edge_primary, mnn_counts, mnn_result, prepared
  )
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

combined_run_summary <- bind_rows(run_summaries)
write_csv_safe(combined_run_summary, file.path(output_root, "12_run_summary.csv"))
knitr::kable(combined_run_summary)
```

# Dataset11 HFpEF threshold concordance

The >=10 analysis is the exploratory HFpEF result and the >=15 analysis is a
stricter receiver-depth sensitivity. This section compares their edgeR effects
and MultiNicheNet priorities without rerunning either model.

```{r hfpef-threshold-concordance}
hfpef_ids <- c(
  min10 = "dataset11_HFpEF_vs_NF_min10",
  min15 = "dataset11_HFpEF_vs_NF_min15"
)
hfpef_edge_paths <- setNames(
  file.path(
    output_root,
    unname(hfpef_ids),
    "tables",
    "12_edgeR_primary_all_genes.csv.gz"
  ),
  names(hfpef_ids)
)
hfpef_priority_paths <- setNames(
  file.path(
    output_root,
    unname(hfpef_ids),
    "tables",
    "12_MultiNicheNet_group_prioritization.csv"
  ),
  names(hfpef_ids)
)
concordance_summary <- list()

if (all(file.exists(hfpef_edge_paths))) {
  edge_min10 <- readr::read_csv(
    hfpef_edge_paths[["min10"]], show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    select(gene, logFC, PValue, FDR, significant_primary, direction) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_min10"), -gene)
  edge_min15 <- readr::read_csv(
    hfpef_edge_paths[["min15"]], show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    select(gene, logFC, PValue, FDR, significant_primary, direction) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_min15"), -gene)
  edge_concordance <- inner_join(edge_min10, edge_min15, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(
      same_logFC_direction = sign(logFC_min10) == sign(logFC_min15),
      significant_both = significant_primary_min10 & significant_primary_min15,
      significant_both_same_direction = significant_both & same_logFC_direction
    )
  write_csv_safe(
    edge_concordance,
    file.path(output_root, "12_dataset11_HFpEF_edgeR_min10_min15_concordance.csv.gz")
  )
  concordance_summary[["edgeR"]] <- tibble(
    component = "edgeR",
    metric = c(
      "common_genes", "logFC_spearman", "same_direction_fraction",
      "significant_min10_among_common_genes",
      "significant_min15_among_common_genes",
      "significant_both_same_direction"
    ),
    value = c(
      nrow(edge_concordance),
      suppressWarnings(cor(
        edge_concordance$logFC_min10,
        edge_concordance$logFC_min15,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "complete.obs"
      )),
      mean(edge_concordance$same_logFC_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(edge_concordance$significant_primary_min10, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(edge_concordance$significant_primary_min15, na.rm = TRUE),
      sum(edge_concordance$significant_both_same_direction, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

if (all(file.exists(hfpef_priority_paths))) {
  priority_columns <- c(
    "contrast", "group", "sender", "receiver", "ligand", "receptor",
    "prioritization_score"
  )
  priority_min10 <- readr::read_csv(
    hfpef_priority_paths[["min10"]], show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    select(all_of(priority_columns)) %>%
    rename(prioritization_score_min10 = prioritization_score)
  priority_min15 <- readr::read_csv(
    hfpef_priority_paths[["min15"]], show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE
  ) %>%
    select(all_of(priority_columns)) %>%
    rename(prioritization_score_min15 = prioritization_score)
  interaction_keys <- setdiff(priority_columns, "prioritization_score")
  priority_concordance <- inner_join(
    priority_min10,
    priority_min15,
    by = interaction_keys
  )
  write_csv_safe(
    priority_concordance,
    file.path(output_root, "12_dataset11_HFpEF_MultiNicheNet_min10_min15_concordance.csv.gz")
  )
  top_min10 <- priority_min10 %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    slice_max(prioritization_score_min10, n = 100, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    unite("interaction_key", all_of(interaction_keys), sep = "||", remove = FALSE)
  top_min15 <- priority_min15 %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    slice_max(prioritization_score_min15, n = 100, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    unite("interaction_key", all_of(interaction_keys), sep = "||", remove = FALSE)
  top_overlap <- length(intersect(top_min10$interaction_key, top_min15$interaction_key))
  top_union <- length(union(top_min10$interaction_key, top_min15$interaction_key))
  concordance_summary[["MultiNicheNet"]] <- tibble(
    component = "MultiNicheNet",
    metric = c(
      "common_prioritized_rows", "priority_score_spearman",
      "top100_per_group_overlap", "top100_per_group_jaccard"
    ),
    value = c(
      nrow(priority_concordance),
      suppressWarnings(cor(
        priority_concordance$prioritization_score_min10,
        priority_concordance$prioritization_score_min15,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "complete.obs"
      )),
      top_overlap,
      if (top_union > 0) top_overlap / top_union else NA_real_
    )
  )
}

if (length(concordance_summary)) {
  hfpef_concordance_summary <- bind_rows(concordance_summary)
  write_csv_safe(
    hfpef_concordance_summary,
    file.path(output_root, "12_dataset11_HFpEF_threshold_concordance_summary.csv")
  )
  knitr::kable(hfpef_concordance_summary)
} else {
  message(
    "HFpEF threshold concordance will be written after both min10 and min15 ",
    "analyses complete."
  )
}
```

# Interpretation guardrails

1. TMM is sufficient for the relative-library normalization component of the
   edgeR count model; it is not the entire donor-control strategy.
2. Donor dominance is addressed structurally by one pseudobulk replicate per
   person, donor-level dispersion, donor-eligibility requirements, sample-level
   prioritization, and donor diagnostics.
3. TMM does not remove age, sex, project, protocol, or dataset confounding.
4. Disease datasets are never pooled for inference; dataset11 HFpEF is compared
   only with dataset11 NF.
5. The 9-versus-4 dataset08 comparison is valid but control-limited; it should
   receive stronger donor-influence scrutiny than the dataset01 comparisons.
6. HFpEF remains non-testable in the minimum-25 branch. The symmetric >=10
   analysis is exploratory and the symmetric >=15 analysis is its receiver-depth
   sensitivity; agreement between them is required for cautious prioritization.
7. NF donors from another dataset are never substituted because that would
   confound HFpEF with dataset, protocol, and sampled heart region.
8. With `resume_completed: true`, a comparison is reused only when its completed
   summary, matching receiver threshold, edgeR table, MultiNicheNet RDS, and
   requested figure manifest are all present and nonempty.
9. Sydney-equivalent figures use an exploratory FDR of 0.25 for visual
   comparability. The primary edgeR decision rule remains FDR 0.05 and absolute
   log2 fold-change at least 0.25.
